Priya (AE): ArborVision POC is paused — CISO flagged three blockers: KMS attestation, a higher throughput SLA, and formal dedicated pricing. They want an exec bridge today.
Asha (Solutions): Copy. Security Q highlights below, will paste exact items we need to answer to CISO.
Asha (Solutions): ```- KMS: BYO key support + attestation on key control processes
- Data residency: EU region only, proof of separation from multi-tenant logs
- SOC2 report + cert expiration date
- Network peering / egress encryption details
- Incident response SLA + contact
```
Connor (Sales Ops): Do we have a committed-capacity pricing sketch? Customer expecting a delta vs hosted. Also need lead time for Dedicated pool.
Mark (VP Sales): I'll join the bridge. @Bryce can you bring infra numbers (throughput, p99 latency) and any fallback model idea?
Bryce (CTO): I'll bring perf numbers and a fallback plan (quantized variant) that reduces GPU footprint. Need token mix & target p99.
Priya (AE): Token mix sent in the doc: 70% short (≈50 tokens), 30% long (≈2048 tokens). Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/arborvision/token-mix (internal).
Eva (Legal): For KMS BYO we usually require a minimal attestation + DPA redlines. I can draft the sample clause; question on whether they need HSM attestation or just KMS API support.
Asha (Solutions): CISO asked for HSM-level controls. We'll confirm exact ask on the call, but prepare both.
Connor (Sales Ops): Pricing options I'll prepare: 1) Reserved Dedicated (6m / 12m) with X% discount, 2) Dedicated + burst, 3) Hosted fallback. Expect sketch in 90 mins.
Priya (AE): Customer CISO available 4:00pm PT for the bridge. Hoping to close technical signoff same day.
Mark (VP Sales): Invite for 4:00pm PT. Pre-brief at 3:30pm PT — 20min run-through. @Eva have SOW template and standard SLA caveats ready.
Bryce (CTO): For the perf numbers I'll bring: tokens/sec at 256/1024/2048, p99 latency, and estimated concurrency with current Dedicated pool. Also note fallback will increase latency slightly but saves ~40% on GPU cost.
Eva (Legal): Will prep DPA + KMS clause and attach to calendar invite. If they push HSM attestation we may need security team sign-off — flagging potential 48–72h delay.
Priya (AE): Customer is ok with a short delay if we can provide an attestation draft during the call. They want to see concrete docs.
Connor (Sales Ops): Quick ask — can Eng confirm lead time to spin a Dedicated pool for the specified size? Ops estimate will affect pricing.
Asha (Solutions): Ops lead time: ~3 business days for a small pool, ~5–7 for larger capacity. I'll confirm exact numbers in pre-brief.
Priya (AE): Action items:
- Asha: KMS attestation draft + perf fallback summary — by EOD.
- Bryce: Throughput numbers + quantized model tradeoffs — by pre-brief 3:30pm PT.
- Connor: Pricing scenarios & commitment options — by 3pm PT.
- Eva: DPA + KMS sample clause — attach to invite.
- Mark/Priya: Run bridge and handle exec ask.
Mark (VP Sales): Good. If we can get commitment language ready we can push for a soft verbal OK on the call.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — pre-brief 3:30pm PT, customer bridge 4:00pm PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.
Priya (AE): Thanks all — see you at 3:30 for pre-brief.
